english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the activity of travelling or sightseeing away from home.
Use this for travel viewed as tourism or holiday travel, especially when contrasting it with work or staying at home.

examples.english: We’re going to Japan for tourism during the summer holidays.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 syu2 gaa3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 jau4
